en: I've been using Pipedrive for the last 11 years and have brought it to each company I've joined since then. In that time, I've added about $68 million in annual recurring revenues as won deals through Pipedrive.
Pipedrive is a very easy and simple software solution. We were able to track all the different markets, our whole sales team's performance, new leads and customer cases easily.

I waited until I had the first 12 months of Pipedrive data, which gave me an analysis of the company performance that just wasn't being seen at the turnover stage. The overall turnover in that 12 months was €11 million.
It’s the best sales tracking software that’s so easy to customise as we go!
The best thing we love about Pipedrive is it does two-way sync with Google Apps. It has helped us to better organise and keep everything on track.
Pipedrive mixes features and design that allows our team to streamline our operations. It was very easy to get up and running with Pipedrive compared to Salesforce.
sr: Pipedrive koristim već 11 godina i uveo sam ga u svaku kompaniju kojoj sam se od tada pridružio. Za to vreme, kroz poslove zaključene u Pipedrive-u ostvario sam oko 68 miliona dolara godišnjeg ponavljajućeg prihoda.
Godišnji ponavljajući prihod (ARR) ostvaren kroz Pipedrive
Pipedrive je veoma jednostavno i lako za korišćenje softversko rešenje. Omogućio nam je da na jednom mestu pratimo različita tržišta, rezultate celog prodajnog tima, nove leadove i klijente.

Sačekao sam da prikupimo prvih 12 meseci podataka u Pipedrive-u, što mi je omogućilo da analiziram rezultate kompanije na način koji ranije nije bio vidljiv samo kroz podatke o prometu. Ukupan promet u tih 12 meseci iznosio je 11 miliona evra.
Direktor prodaje i marketinga, McKeon Group
To je najbolji softver za praćenje prodaje koji je pritom veoma jednostavan za prilagođavanje kako se naše potrebe menjaju.
Ono što nam se kod Pipedrive-a najviše dopada jeste dvosmerna sinhronizacija sa Google aplikacijama. Pomogao nam je da bolje organizujemo posao i da sve držimo pod kontrolom.
Pipedrive kombinuje funkcionalnosti i dizajn koji našem timu omogućavaju da pojednostavi način rada. U poređenju sa Salesforce-om, početak rada u Pipedrive-u bio je veoma jednostavan.
